card.title: LEND LEASE
card.flavorText: The Lend-Lease program, formally titled “An Act to Promote the Defense of the United States”, was a program where the United States supplied the Allied nations with food, oil, materials and weaponry between 1941 and 1945. For most part the aid was free, but some hardware such as ships were returned after the war. A total of $50.1 billion ($697 billion today) worth of supplies were shipped, most of it going to Britain and the Soviet Union
